topics.title: The Hunger Bill: Why Hormuz Reaches Your Plate in 2027
topics.angle: Hormuz carries ~29% of urea trade; diesel spread >$100/bbl; El Nino. Farmers buy inputs months ahead, so the food bill lands a season later. Bangladesh 4 of 5 urea plants shut since Mar 2026.
evidence: DW 'Who will the diesel crisis hit first?' 309K
vidIQ 'food security' searches +156%, 'food inflation' +82%

evidence: 'What Would Happen to the World Economy If WW3 Began?' 175.7K, 434x breakout (1.6K-sub channel)
